rationale: The assistant correctly identified transit bolts as the likely cause, asked the right first question, and gave safe unplugged instructions. It handled the capped hole sensibly and set out warranty escalation only if shaking persisted. The user confirmed the machine was much quieter and stayed put. Minor issues: the instructions were repeated across turns, and a few claims were speculative, such as the fourth hole being capped at the factory and 'a couple of days' use... usually does no lasting harm'.
